title: NoveraEvent
description: NoveraEvent (Novera Protocol Specification v0.1, pre-production). A protocol-level record of a proposal, validation, confirmation, rejection, state transition or external observation concerning one Novera record. A proposal is not a state change: the current state of a record changes only through a state_transition event, and only state_transition events carry confirmedStateRef. Events do not imply blockchain or legal finality; persistence MAY later involve one or more storage or network adapters.

eventId.description: Opaque event identifier. Implementations MUST reject a second event with an eventId they have already accepted.

eventType.description: Kind of event. Closed vocabulary, because authority rules depend on it; new event types require a specification revision. proposal: a requested state, with no effect on current state. validation: policy evaluation of a proposal. confirmation: an authorized actor approves a proposed state; current state is unchanged until a state_transition is recorded. rejection: a proposal is declined or fails validation. state_transition: the confirmed state becomes the record's current state. external_observation: an adapter or external provider reports a fact from outside Novera.

subjectType.description: Type of the record the event concerns.

subjectId.description: Opaque identifier of the record the event concerns. The prefix MUST match subjectType.

workflowId.description: NovaDeed workflow in whose context the event occurred, when the subject is not itself that workflow.

actorRef.description: Actor responsible for the event. Which actor types may emit which event types is constrained below.

previousStateRef.description: Version of the subject the event is based on, or null when the event concerns creation of the subject. Implementations MUST reject a proposal or state_transition whose previousStateRef is not the subject's current version, which prevents stale and replayed transitions.

proposedStateRef.description: State requested by a proposal, or the proposed state that a validation, confirmation or rejection concerns.

confirmedStateRef.description: State that became the subject's current state. Present only on state_transition events.

causedBy.description: Earlier events this event responds to or depends on, for example the proposal a confirmation approves.

evidenceRefs.description: Evidence relied on by the event.

policyResultRefs.description: Policy results relied on by the event.

confidence.description: Producer-reported confidence, REQUIRED when the actor is an assistive system. Informational only.

provenance.description: How the event came to be recorded.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional producer-supplied key. Implementations SHOULD treat a repeated key from the same actor as a retry of the same request and MUST NOT apply it twice.

timestamp.description: When the event was recorded by the implementation. Not a statement of legal effective time or network finality.

allOf.description: A state transition is applied by a deterministic Novera system component.
A proposal names the requested state and the version it is based on.
A validation cites at least one policy result for a stated proposal.
A confirmation approves a stated proposal and is made by an authorized participant, an external provider or a deterministic system component.
An external observation reports an outside fact; it neither proposes nor applies state.
An assistive system may only propose, must report confidence, and must disclose extraction provenance.

channel.description: How the event originated: direct_action (an actor acted through an authenticated interface), policy_evaluation, external_report (an external provider reported), adapter_observation, assistive_extraction (a non-authoritative assistive system produced it), system_process (a deterministic system process produced it).

sourceRef.description: Opaque reference to the originating external record or report, such as a provider's report identifier. MUST NOT contain personal data or credentials.

networkRefs.description: Network references associated with the event, when an adapter observed or anchored it.

extraction.description: Extraction details, REQUIRED when the actor is an assistive system.
Details of an assistive extraction. Describes what produced a proposal; it confers no authority.

modelIdentifier.description: Identifier and version of the model or component that produced the output.

inputEvidenceRefs.description: Evidence the extraction read. Every proposed value MUST be traceable to these inputs.

items.description: Provenance of one proposed field value.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the proposed field within the proposed record.

evidenceId.description: Evidence the value was extracted from.

locator.description: Location within the evidence, such as page 3 or section 2.1.
